pages.title: A key. A garden. A beginning.
pages.text: Your grandmother left you the homestead—and a key wrapped in a delivery ledger. Her note is brief: “The garden can feed more than one household. Start there.”

pages.title: The roads between us.
pages.text: Beyond Dewhaven, three towns still rely on roads the winter storms have damaged. Aya, the valley courier, brings you as far as the old bridge.

pages.title: What she left growing.
pages.text: The farmhouse is standing. The beds need tending, the shipping crate needs a hinge, and a few of Grandmother's crops are ready to gather.

pages.title: Your first morning.
pages.text: At six, sunlight reaches the bedroom floor. Mira opens the seedhouse at eight. There is time to plant your first rows before walking into town.
